data.name: MAN EAT MAN
data.detailed_description:
Man Eat Man is a turn-based strategy RPG that thrusts its players into a medieval world where famine and war will stampede the Earth…

...unless they rise to be the leader the world needs.

Set in a fantastical re-imagining of the story of mankind, Man Eat Man is a window to a brutal age of mystery and terror.

Simulated medieval societies populate an ever-changing and unforgiving landscape. Lead your faction to victory amidst the chaos of war.

  • Secure your holdings in a hostile land. Man Eat Man’s dynamic setting offers fresh experiences every playthrough with procedurally generated environments and randomized encounters!

  • Personalize your champions and your faction to play out your own fantasy warcraft. Equip your commanders with the best arms money can buy, and train your troops into an unstoppable army!

  • Develop your lands to offer nourishment and hospitable shelter to your beleaguered subjects. Care after your people well to help them reach their full potential!

  • Shelter against the frigid winds of death and shield yourself from the night’s terrors!

Your troops are your teeth and claws; rip apart your enemies with unique weapon classes and skills! Spearmen, axemen, archers, and more: all at the ready to champion your cause.

In constitution, and equipment, the different troop classes each offer their own set of advantages and vulnerabilities. Veteran axes may fell even the sturdiest spear-wall, and elite bodyguard infantry might crumble underhoof amidst a stampede of cavalry. Engineers construct fortifications, traps, and mighty siege engines for your cause. 

Even the laws of nature may bend to your might: wield forbidden magic and recruit rogue sorcerers to summon dark powers in your name!

Use your troops’ specializations to seize a decisive victory! Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies to shatter their morale… and when the blood begins to flow, may panic sweep your foe off the face of the battlefield!

Your territories are populous – and people need food and shelter to work! Organizing an effective workforce takes meeting the needs of your people. Fear not – your investment in their lives will offer bountiful rewards, as their health equates to productivity.

From constructing and repairing buildings in your towns, to farming the land to reap nature’s boons; administrating your lands attentively is the key to fostering a powerful workforce – and in turn, powerful armies!   

Countless lives hang in a precarious balance. Tip the scales of fortune in your favor, and see your people flourish against violence and deprivation.

Since the very earliest stories of man, we have known evil, from within… and without. On this accursed Earth, there are monsters – begotten of cruelty, they stalk the land in search of victims with mindless abandon.

Demons. Spirits. MANDRAKES.

Mandrakes are the eternal nemesis of humanity, the evil spawn of mankind’s collective and unconscious self-hatred. Wheresoever mankind wounds himself, mandrakes will fester – and war wounds all it touches.

Beware the horrors that lurk at night, lest terror devour you whole.

data.short_description: A turn-based medieval strategy war game. Administrate your strongholds, raise your armies, and strive for survival against forces both natural and demonic. Uplift your commanders from fledgling aspirants to formidable champions. Immerse yourself in an intricate dark fantasy world like none other!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6300 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or i5/Ryzen 5 for better performance)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 560 (or GTX 1050 Ti / RX 470)
